en_title: EA Halts Development on Mobile Multiplayer Sims Game in Favor of Rumored Sims 4 Sequel
cn_title: EA搁置手游，转向《模拟人生4》续作
subtitle: 续作并非《模拟人生5》
opus_summary: EA暂停开发多人手游Project Lotus，转而推进传闻中的《模拟人生4》续作Project Evergreen。后者据称计划于2027年9月完成开发定版，并在同年秋季登陆PC，还将针对Steam Deck等掌机优化。

paragraphs.en: EA has paused development on a mobile multiplayer Sims game in favor of moving forward with a rumored Sims 4 sequel.
paragraphs.cn: EA暂停开发一款《模拟人生》多人手游，转而推进传闻中的《模拟人生4》续作。

paragraphs.en: EA announced a wide variety of changes and projects today, including the closure of BioWare and the cancelation of Mass Effect 5 . It also seemed to lean into recent rumors that DICE and Respawn are making a new Star Wars Battlefront game . One other big change is that EA is shelving a mobile-first multiplayer Sims project, formerly known as Project Rene and now known as Project Lotus. The game was once envisioned as the next big Sims title , but plans changed to more of a mobile spin-off once EA saw that people were still hanging on to The Sims 4.
paragraphs.cn: EA今天公布了多项变动和项目，其中包括关闭BioWare，以及取消《质量效应5》。EA似乎也在呼应近期传闻，DICE和Respawn正在开发一款新的《星球大战：前线》游戏。另一项重大变动是，EA搁置了一款以移动平台为主的《模拟人生》多人游戏项目。该项目此前名为Project Rene，如今名为Project Lotus。EA最初曾将它设想为《模拟人生》系列的下一款大型作品，但在发现玩家仍然钟情于《模拟人生4》后，便将计划调整为更偏向手游衍生作的方向。

paragraphs.en: With that game being put on the back burner, EA is shifting its focus to a Sims title that it's calling Project Evergreen. Although EA hasn't revealed what the focus of this game will be, rumors have been swirling about this project for a some time now. The game, which was rumored to be under the codename Project X, is expected to be a sequel to The Sims 4. Now, here's where it may get a bit confusing: It's not The Sims 5. It's being viewed more like The Sims 4 2.0. I know, it is unnecessarily complicated.
paragraphs.cn: EA暂缓这款游戏后，正把重心转向一款暂称Project Evergreen的《模拟人生》作品。EA尚未透露这款游戏的具体方向，但关于该项目的传闻已经流传了一段时间。据传，这款游戏的代号是Project X，预计将成为《模拟人生4》的续作。这里可能有点令人困惑：它并不是《模拟人生5》，更像是《模拟人生4》2.0版。我知道，这说法复杂得没必要。

paragraphs.en: As covered by Sims Community , the project is reportedly targeting September 2027 as its deadline to go gold, suggesting the game would launch in fall 2027. The game will release on PC and is also expected to be optimized for portable handhelds, such as the Steam Deck. If it really is releasing next year, we will likely hear more about it at The Game Awards or sometime in the first half of 2027.
paragraphs.cn: 据Sims Community报道，该项目据称计划在2027年9月完成开发定版，这意味着游戏可能会于2027年秋季发售。游戏将登陆PC，预计也会针对Steam Deck等便携掌机进行优化。如果游戏确实会在明年发售，我们可能会在The Game Awards上，或是在2027年上半年听到更多消息。

paragraphs.en: Earlier this year, the team behind The Sims hinted at a new single-player game in the franchise for PC and console, noting that half of its development team was working on The Sims 4 and its "next evolution."
paragraphs.cn: 今年早些时候，《模拟人生》团队曾暗示，系列将推出一款面向PC和主机平台的单人新作，并表示团队中有一半成员正在开发《模拟人生4》及其「下一阶段进化」。

paragraphs.en: Ultimately, this sounds like a win for fans who have been hoping for a new traditional entry in the franchise. The Sims 4 was released in 2014, meaning it has been 12 years since the franchise got a new game. There are a ton of updates and expansions that keep the game fresh, but building something from scratch and moving away from all the bloat could be a strong move for the future of the series.
paragraphs.cn: 总的来说，这对一直期待系列推出传统新作的粉丝而言是个好消息。《模拟人生4》于2014年发售，距系列推出新作已经12年。大量更新和资料片让这款游戏保持新鲜感，但从头打造新作、摆脱现有内容的臃肿，或许会是系列未来发展的有力一步。
